messages:
maria: FYI vendor engagement confirmed. We need a compact retest acceptance checklist, RBAC pattern for assessors, KMS logging gating, and who signs off on remediation. Avoid long-lived creds.

sam: I'll own the remediation acceptance language in the contract. Mandatory: 72h P1 window, exploit repro within 24h, and written verification of fix before retest. Also add a comms channel requirement (Slack + email).

lina: For RBAC, do ephemeral STS with session tags and scope to a per-engagement S3 prefix + CloudTrail read. No cross-account write access. If assessors need to run scans, provide isolated test namespaces and ephemeral kube credentials.

eva: Evidence packaging plan: create per-engagement read-only S3 prefix, generate a signed manifest (sha256) and produce a detached signature file signed with our ops GPG key so vendor can verify integrity. We'll also include a small README with verification steps.

jack: KMS notes: never share raw key material. Use grants with EncryptionContext requirements and log grant creation/revocation. CloudTrail will show kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt events. Ops must ensure those events flow to SIEM.

ops-bot: System: CloudTrail -> SIEM forwarding is active to index "security_audit". KMS events included. Retention: 90d hot, 365d cold. To request extended retention open INF-LOG-EXT ticket.

maria: Retest acceptance draft: 1) fix merged and deployed to canary 2) smoke tests pass 3) no repro in logs for 48h 4) KMS audit shows only expected Decrypts tied to the retest window 5) vendor provides written confirmation. Jack to certify, Sam fallback.

sam: Add: must include correlation IDs in logs for every verification step so we can map vendor reproduction to CloudTrail/KMS events. Also require a minimal smoke test script be added to the triage ticket.

jack: I'll create a verification board template with columns: reported, triage, fix PR, deployed, verified, retest-scheduled. Verification checklist items: repro steps, smoke test script, logs attached, manifest sha256s, KMS CloudTrail event ids, ops retention proof.

eva: Example commands for playbook: 

```bash
# make presigned bundle available for 24h
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/${ENG_ID}/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
# produce sha256 manifest and sign it with ops key
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
gpg --output bundle.sig --detach-sign --local-user ops@redwood.com bundle.sha256
# revoke a KMS grant after window
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id "$GRANT_ID"
```

eva: I'll include a small script to extract relevant CloudTrail entries by correlation id and a sample jq filter.

lina: Important ops caveat: if assessors request live queries against DB or secrets, deny and offer a sanitized read replica or truncated dataset. Document this on the README.

maria: Dry-run plan: Thu 11:00 UTC. We'll simulate a P1, create bundle, issue ephemeral creds, then revoke and run the rollback/rollforward drill. Everyone expected.

ops-bot: Reminder: Dry-run Thu 11:00 UTC. Automated preflight checklist will post at T-1h.

sam: I'll push contract text and the rollback playbook draft to the ticket today.

jack: I'll spin up the triage board and post the link here, plus invite for Thur dry-run. Primary verifier will be me.

eva: I'll publish the evidence packaging script and verification README to the ticket, including the GPG verify steps.

maria: Action items recap: sam=contract+rollback, eva=evidence+signing+scripts, jack=triage board+verify checklist, ops=confirm SIEM/KMS forwarding and retention. We'll iterate in this thread. Thanks :lock:
